clue.text: Trouble in the street or in the fields

indicators.note: the trouble is placed in the street, so one word sits inside the other

parts.note: a mews is a small street of converted stables
ado means fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: A choice between unrest in town and in the open countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'or in' simply links the wordplay to the definition. A mews is a typically British row of former stables, now homes.
explanation.definitionFit: Meadows are grassland fields, often for hay or grazing.

clue.text: Performance with a maiden is a crime

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
taken as written
a deed is an act or performance

explanation.surface: Doing something with a young unmarried woman is criminal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Performance' is printed first but its piece comes last. In cricket a maiden is an over with no runs scored.
explanation.definitionFit: A misdeed is a wrongful act, an offence.

clue.text: A group just about finished and left

parts.note: a band is a group, of musicians for instance

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the first letter of the word for finished goes to the back

parts.note: done means finished

explanation.surface: A band has nearly ended its set and gone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'just about' moves the D of DONE to the end, giving ONED.
explanation.definitionFit: Abandoned means deserted, forsaken, left behind.

clue.text: Body part in which people stop tickling

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters across the words that follow

explanation.surface: A part of the body where people stop tickling one another.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'stOP TICkling'; 'people' is padding.
explanation.definitionFit: Optic is an old or humorous word for the eye.

clue.text: In turn the artist shows sign of strain

indicators.note: the artist is placed in the word for turn

parts.note: a spin is a turn
RA, Royal Academician, is a crossword artist

explanation.surface: The painter twists round and shows signs of stress.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shows sign of' links the wordplay to the definition; 'turn' is a noun here, not a verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To sprain a joint is to wrench or overstretch it, a kind of injury from overloading.

clue.text: Signalling success before a ruler

indicators.note: the word for success comes before the word for ruler

parts.note: a win is a success
a king is a ruler

explanation.surface: A gesture marking a triumph ahead of a monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Winking is closing one eye briefly as a sign or hint.

clue.text: Cautioner about engineer being keeper

indicators.note: the word for cautioner goes around the engineer

parts.note: a warner is someone who cautions
RE, the Royal Engineers, stands for an engineer

explanation.surface: Someone giving a warning about a mechanic who turns out to be a caretaker.
explanation.walkthrough: The Royal Engineers is a British Army corps. A warren is a rabbit enclosure, hence the keeper.
explanation.definitionFit: A warrener is the man who looks after a rabbit warren, a gamekeeper of sorts.

clue.text: Unusual things as book matches

parts.note: a novel is a book
ties are drawn games or matches

explanation.surface: Odd items such as a book of matches.
explanation.walkthrough: In British sport a tie is a match, as in a cup tie.
explanation.definitionFit: Novelties are new or unusual objects, often trinkets.

clue.text: Former Pakistan captain for whom a cockney scored

indicators.note: a Londoner's accent drops the H at the front of a word

parts.note: whom is the object form, as him is
a batsman ran when scoring runs

explanation.surface: A Pakistani cricket captain for whom a Londoner made runs.
explanation.walkthrough: A cockney says 'im for him. Cockneys are working-class Londoners whose accent drops initial H.
explanation.definitionFit: Imran Khan captained Pakistan's cricket team before entering politics.

clue.text: One of those animal products has a country sound

indicators.note: the answer is said the same way as a phrase the clue words make

parts.note: Greece is a country; Greece's can stand for Greece has

explanation.surface: Some animal produce has a rural ring to it.
explanation.walkthrough: Greece's is said the same as the answer. 'country' looks like rural, but it names a nation.
explanation.definitionFit: Greases are animal fats such as lard and dripping.

clue.text: Ruin a second Luton person

parts.note: Luton, a town north of London, was famous for hat-making, and its football club is nicknamed the Hatters

explanation.surface: A second person from Luton ruins things.
explanation.walkthrough: Luton is an English town long known for straw hats.
explanation.definitionFit: To shatter is to smash or wreck completely.

clue.text: Upset for Britannia's place

definitions.meaning: the figure of Britannia appeared on the tails side of old British pennies

explanation.surface: A setback for the figure of Britannia.
explanation.walkthrough: Britannia, the seated female figure, was on the back of British coins, the side opposite the monarch's head.
explanation.definitionFit: A reverse is a misfortune, and it is also the tails side of a coin.

clue.text: This country's about finished holding credit with me for body parts

indicators.note: the country's name goes around the rest

parts.note: the paper is British, so this country is England

indicators.note: the word for finished holds credit and me inside it

parts.note: done means finished
I stands for me

explanation.surface: A nation nearly done with credit lends me some organs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' and 'holding' both mark containers, one inside the other; the inner pair builds DOCRINE.
explanation.definitionFit: Endocrine glands, such as the thyroid, secrete hormones directly into the blood.

clue.text: Man's opposite is done wrong

indicators.note: the opposite way round means read backwards

parts.note: sinned means did wrong

explanation.surface: A man's opposite has behaved badly.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is': a man (a man's name) is the opposite of SINNED.
explanation.definitionFit: Dennis is a man's first name.

clue.text: Involve the devil departed holding one caught

parts.note: an imp is a little devil

indicators.note: the word for departed holds one and caught

parts.note: late means dead, departed
I is the Roman numeral for one
C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: The devil gets entangled with a dead man who was arrested.
explanation.walkthrough: I and C go inside LATE.
explanation.definitionFit: To implicate someone is to show them to be connected with a crime.

clue.text: Former West Indian captain in genuine second recoveries

indicators.note: the captain is placed in the word for genuine

parts.note: real means genuine
Viv Richards captained the West Indies at cricket

explanation.surface: A cricket captain's genuine second recoveries.
explanation.walkthrough: Viv Richards was the great West Indies batsman of the 1970s and 80s.
explanation.definitionFit: Revivals are renewals or comebacks.

clue.text: Heavenly morning and relatives absurdly ail

parts.note: bros, brothers, are relatives

indicators.note: absurdly signals the letters of ail are rearranged

explanation.surface: Morning and family members feel silly and sickly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'absurdly' turns AIL into IAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambrosia was the food of the gods, so ambrosial means divinely delicious.

clue.text: Cunning Edward sounds insulted

indicators.note: sounds signals that the clue words are said aloud to give the answer

parts.note: sly means cunning, and Ted is short for Edward

explanation.surface: A crafty man named Edward seems offended.
explanation.definitionFit: Slighted means treated with disrespect or snubbed.

clue.text: Aubergine makes the old woman marked with spots

parts.note: ma is mother, the old woman in slang
dapple describes something marked with spots

explanation.surface: An aubergine turns Mum blotchy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the old woman' is British slang for one's mother or wife.
explanation.definitionFit: Mad-apple is an old name for the eggplant.

clue.text: Master nothing found in pieces although a great expert

indicators.note: in pieces says the letters are broken up and reassembled

parts.note: O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A master with nothing to show, although a great expert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found' joins O to MASTER before the letters are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A maestro is a distinguished master of an art, especially music.

clue.text: Bachelor retreats in lies about a girl

indicators.note: a bachelor withdrawing into a place goes inside it
about signals the letters of lies and a are rearranged

explanation.surface: A single man hides away among lies about a young woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' rearranges LIES and A as ISAEL; B goes inside to make the name.
explanation.definitionFit: Isabel is a female first name.

clue.text: The way the wind blows there is a tiny rise in fat

indicators.note: the risen word goes in the word for fat

parts.note: lard is pig fat

indicators.note: in a down clue rising means read upwards, backwards

parts.note: wee means tiny

explanation.surface: Sailing lore: where the wind goes, there is a little rise in fat.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'rise' turns the small word upwards, giving EEW. Wee is Scottish for small.
explanation.definitionFit: Leeward is the direction downwind, away from where the wind comes.

clue.text: Devised or victimised

definitions.meaning: ... in the sense of formulated or composed
... in the sense of falsely incriminated

explanation.definitionFit: To frame a plan is to devise it; to frame someone is to set them up for a crime.

clue.text: Oenothera equalling a formal flower

parts.note: evening means making equal
prim means stiffly formal
a rose is a flower

explanation.surface: A botanical name made equal to a stiff bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: Oenothera is the botanical genus of yellow flowers that open at dusk.

clue.text: Banish in trying to annex Peloponesian state

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters across the words named

explanation.surface: Greek history: banishment in the attempt to take over a state in the Peloponnese.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters run across 'annEX PELoponesian'. The surface sounds like ancient Greek wars.
explanation.definitionFit: To expel is to drive out or banish.

clue.text: Tragic heroine who holds me endlessly beloved

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: the word for beloved loses its final letter

parts.note: dear means beloved

explanation.surface: A tragic heroine who holds me dear.
explanation.walkthrough: DEAR without its last letter gives DEA.
explanation.definitionFit: Medea is the sorceress of Greek myth, the subject of Euripides' tragedy.

clue.text: Drink about the leading statesman being on a ship

indicators.note: the drink is placed about the statesman and being

parts.note: a tot is a small drink
PM, the Prime Minister, leads the government
as can mean being, as in 'as it was late'

explanation.surface: A drink for the Prime Minister on board a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: something found on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: A topmast is a spar fixed above the lower mast of a sailing vessel.

clue.text: Drink constituted with wild Irishmen

parts.note: made means constituted, formed
the IRA, the Irish Republican Army, a militant group

explanation.surface: A drink is made with rowdy Irishmen.
explanation.definitionFit: Madeira is a fortified wine from the Portuguese island.

clue.text: The product of rape does lie badly

indicators.note: badly signals that the letters of does lie are rearranged

explanation.surface: A grim-sounding phrase, then a deer lies about clumsily.
explanation.walkthrough: Rape here is the crop oilseed rape, with yellow flowers grown for oil.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapeseed is pressed for cooking oil, so its seed is an oil-bearing seed.

clue.text: Uttered slowly, "Was in front after not winning"

indicators.note: the word for was in front comes after the word for not winning

parts.note: a draw is a game with no winner
led means was in front

explanation.surface: A racer explains that after failing to win they were in front.
explanation.definitionFit: To drawl is to speak in a slow lazy way.
